Watto's Junk ShopStar Wars: Episode I, The Phantom MenaceTatooine heat. Cold drinks.Every recipe serves 4.
    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersMos Espa pear, nectarine and feta platterSliced pears and nectarines with honey, feta and toasted pistachiosHow to make it2 pears3 nectarines2 tbsp honey100g feta, crumbled100g pistachios, toasted and roughly choppedSlice the pears and nectarines thinly and fan out on a big board.Drizzle with honey, then scatter with feta and pistachios. Serve straight away.Podrace grandstand skewersYoghurt and cumin lamb skewers grilled hot, drizzled with lemon tahiniHow to make it600g lamb leg, cubed300g Greek yoghurt2 tsp ground cumin3 garlic cloves, crushed1 tsp salt3 tbsp tahini2 lemons, juiced3 tbsp waterMarinate the lamb in the yoghurt, cumin, garlic and salt for an hour.Thread onto skewers and grill hot and fast, turning.Whisk the tahini with lemon juice and water until smooth and drizzle over to serve.Otoh Gunga tempura bubble prawnsThe underwater Gungan cityHow to make itAs written, serves 4King prawns in an ice-cold tempura batter fried until puffed and bubbly, with a soy, lime and chilli dipping sauce and sesame mayo.Peel and devein 16 green king prawns, leaving the tails on, and score the bellies so they stay straight.Whisk 100g plain flour, 30g cornflour and 200ml ice-cold soda water until just mixed and still lumpy.Dip the prawns and fry at 180°C for 2 minutes until puffed and pale gold.Mix 3 tbsp soy, the juice of a lime and a sliced chilli.Mix 3 tbsp mayonnaise with 1 tsp sesame oil.Grilled corn with chilli butterNow this is podracing.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsShmi's harissa chicken and chickpeasHarissa chicken thighs roasted over chickpeas and onions, flatbread, cucumber yoghurtHow to make it1kg chicken thighs2 tbsp harissa1 lemon, juiced1 tsp salt800g chickpeas, drained2 red onions, sliced4 flatbreads1 Lebanese cucumber, grated200g Greek yoghurtRub the chicken with harissa, lemon juice and salt.Spread the chickpeas and onions in a tray and sit the chicken on top.Roast at 200°C for 40 minutes.Mix the cucumber into the yoghurt. Warm the flatbreads and serve everything together.Theed palace fennel pork with polentaThe grand palace in TheedHow to make itAs written, serves 4Pork loin roasted with fennel, garlic and white wine, sliced over soft parmesan polenta with blistered roasted grapes and the pan juices.Rub a 1.2kg pork loin with crushed fennel seeds, 3 garlic cloves, olive oil and salt.Roast at 200°C for 50 minutes with 2 sliced fennel bulbs and 150ml white wine in the tray, adding 300g red grapes for the last 15 minutes.Rest 10 minutes.Whisk 200g instant polenta into 1L simmering stock and cook 5 minutes, then stir in 40g butter and 50g parmesan.Slice the pork over the polenta.SweetsDuel of the Fates red and blue tartCustard tart with raspberries on one half and blueberries on the otherHow to make it2 sheets of sweet shortcrust pastry500ml thick vanilla custard125g raspberries125g blueberries3 tbsp apricot jamLine a tart tin with the pastry and blind bake at 180°C until golden. Cool.Fill with the custard. Cover one half with raspberries and the other half with blueberries, meeting in a clean line.Brush with warm apricot jam to glaze and chill.DrinksTatooine blue milkCold milk and coconut milk blended with honey and tinted blue, no alcoholHow to make it750ml cold milk250ml coconut milk2 tbsp honey1 tsp blue food colouring1 handful iceBlend the milk, coconut milk, honey and ice until frothy.Add a few drops of blue colouring and blend until evenly pale blue. Serve icy cold.
